race.comment: SASSY FOR SURE (5) is a new arrival in the Trevor Montgomerie stable and lines up for the first time in 16 weeks. Ran exclusively at Saturday metro level last prep, the best effort a third over 1050m at Morphettville Parks. Recent trial winner who has the talent to take this out. PICK 'N' MIX (1) has transferred to the Dunn/Bishop barn since finishing last of eight over this distance at Sandown 25 days ago. Won a Strathalbyn jump-out on Tuesday so she looks to have settled in well. Definite contender. RUSSIAN BOBSHARK (4) has not raced since July 2025. Going well at the jump-outs so worth monitoring for market support. SHUTTLE RUN (7) might need this run but is capable of sneaking into the top four.
